description: Links Swell shipments back to the ShipStation shipment they came from

shipment_id.description: ShipStation shipmentId. Used to recognise repeated webhook deliveries so the same shipment is never recorded twice.

batch_number.description: ShipStation batch number, when the label was bought as part of a batch.

voided.description: Set when ShipStation reports the label as voided. The Swell shipment is canceled at the same time.
